status: candidate; complete main/helper/caller/strategy fresh gate still mandatory
verification_scope: Repaired and disclosed compatible C-shim modular partial correctness under explicit reviewed intrinsic specifications

hardware.RVV: RVV1.0 fixed VLEN128, SEW32, LMUL2, VLMAX8, XLEN64; all architecturally legal VL; inactive lanes unconstrained

floating_point.domain: Every binary32 value including quiet/signaling NaN payloads, infinities and signed zero
floating_point.configuration: RNE; DN/FZ/FIZ/AH/traps disabled; FP exception flags not observed
floating_point.observation: IEEE numeric equality or both NaN; signed zeros may compare equal; no all-output bit equality claim
floating_point.computation: Original ordered nine-FMA stencil followed by propagating min/max; no associativity assumption

public_domain.dimensions: H>0, N>0; input_width=4*N; padding_top=1; exact unsigned64 address geometry from ProgramModel.dw_inputs and public caller contracts
public_domain.read_windows: Input H*N+3 float cells, supplied zero row N+3, ten weights, two clamp parameters; each actual read must be initialized
public_domain.read_aliasing: One shared readonly map; input, zero, weights and parameters may overlap
public_domain.write_aliasing: One owned output map covers H*N cells; clipped last rows may alias, stores execute o2 then o1 then o0
public_domain.output_read_overlap: The actual public separation contract dw_data(F) * dw_output(W,O) applies; arbitrary output/readonly overlap is not asserted
public_domain.unwritten_frame: Own prior option values preserved at every unwritten address, including None

evidence_boundary: Component/native/SDK/source-audit successes do not constitute whole-kernel admission; exact final sources, fresh QCP, ordinary Coq, interfaces and assumptions must all pass
